content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR {{THYROID}} CAN'T FUNCTION WITHOUT
facts: **Copper** (Energy Spark) – quietly helps your body turn iron into usable energy; without enough, you can feel wiped out even with normal iron levels.
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) – works behind the scenes with calcium to keep bones dense and joints cushioned, yet almost nobody talks about it.
**Selenium** (Thyroid Shield) – just 1 Brazil nut/day covers your daily need and protects thyroid cells from oxidative damage.
**Potassium** (Pressure Regulator) – helps relax blood vessel walls, easing pressure on your heart with every beat.
**Iodine** (Hormone Fuel) – your thyroid literally cannot make hormones without it, controlling how fast your body burns energy.
**Chromium** (Blood Sugar Helper) – helps insulin do its job more efficiently, smoothing out blood sugar swings after meals.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Copper doesn't get much credit, but it works as a partner to iron — your body can have 'enough' iron on paper and still feel drained if copper is low, because copper helps transport and activate it properly. Manganese is another quiet one: it activates enzymes involved in collagen formation, which is part of why joints and connective tissue need it just as much as bones do. And selenium isn't just a thyroid helper — it also acts as an antioxidant, helping neutralize cell damage that builds up over time. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
